capabilities: compare vault files against the latest scaffold manifest
report missing, edited, and upstream-changed files with changelog links
check folder structure, enabled plugins, and saved view targets
assess note quality such as orphans, dangling links, and inbox captures
generate a prompt for an AI to propose fixes
disambiguation: Not a scaffolding or update tool; it never modifies the vault and only writes a single report note for manual or AI-driven fixes.
extras: Beta software with rough edges expected; only works on the device where the scaffold was installed, since Obsidian Sync does not carry dot folders. Part of the ICOR for Life suite; makes at most two network GET requests for manifests and sends nothing about the vault.
problem: Vaults drift silently as folders move, plugins get disabled, and updates change edited files, with no way to tell later what broke.

relations.evidence: the AI team is its own product, myPKA, with its own version folder
